title: poa annua subsp. pilantha
intro:
Poa annua subsp. pilantha, commonly known as annual bluegrass or European poa, is a perennial grassy weed that belongs to the family Poaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Poa annua subsp. pilantha include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
